competitors.persona: Sales reps (SDRs/AEs), sales leaders, RevOps, marketers, and founders running outbound. Specifically: 'individual sellers doing regular outbound' (Basic), 'full-time reps needing AI features' (Professional), 'teams needing enterprise controls' (Custom).

competitors.ai_pricing: AI is included in paid tiers (AI Assistant on all, AI Research from Basic, AI Lead Scoring from Professional). Credit consumption powers AI-researched data and enrichment. No separate AI SKU — AI is integral to the credit economy.
competitors.free_tier: Free tier is permanent (no time limit): 900 credits/seat/year, 2 sequences, 5 AI Assistant chats, contact/account data access, prospecting + Gmail extensions. Full-feature trial of paid plans also available.

competitors.monday_angle: Apollo is the dominant PLG GTM data competitor with 600K+ companies and a $250M ARR flywheel. Its move into agentic execution (prospecting → pipeline → close) puts it on a collision course with monday CRM's AI agents story — especially if monday CRM's ICP overlaps with Apollo's core SMB/mid-market outbound segment.
competitors.other_insights: Apollo's moat is data scale: 240M contacts + 30M companies is hard to replicate. The 'GTM Harness' concept (training agents on your ICP/playbooks) is a strong counter to generic AI tools. Apollo Anywhere (Chrome, Claude, ChatGPT integration) reduces friction for teams that don't want to switch tools — a strategic hedge. Credits model can be confusing/frustrating for users expecting unlimited usage. Apollo is on a clear trajectory toward IPO given $250M ARR. The April 2025 rebrand from 'sales intelligence' to 'agentic GTM platform' is a deliberate category move.

competitors.monday_angle: monday CRM IS monday — this is our own product. Key internal insight: the AI-included-in-Standard pricing model ($17/seat/month) is a strong differentiator vs Apollo (credit caps) and Attio (credit purchasing). The 'live in minutes' positioning addresses the #1 CRM objection (setup complexity). Risk: monday CRM's AI agents need to prove they're as capable as purpose-built tools (Attio's self-building graph, Gong's conversation intelligence, Apollo's 240M contact database). The MCP Block and Vibe integration signal that monday CRM is becoming an AI platform, not just a CRM product.
competitors.other_insights: monday CRM's 'Ultimate' plan was previously called 'Enterprise' — a rebrand that may indicate a move toward more mid-market positioning. The AI Workflow Builder (Pro+) and Human-in-the-Loop approval block (Aug 2026) show maturing agentic governance. monday.com's position as a public company with ~$1.1B platform ARR gives monday CRM credibility and distribution that pure-play CRM competitors lack. The 'Vibe app builder' feature (generate custom apps from text) aligns monday CRM with the broader no-code/AI platform movement. Strong international presence given HIPAA compliance and GDPR readiness. Partnership program for CRM resellers is an underutilized GTM lever.
